description: This file contains validation functions for Kubernetes core v1 resources, including resource requirements, container resource names, pod log options, and port validation.

methods.name: ValidateResourceRequirements
methods.description: Validates resource limits and requests in a ResourceRequirements object.

methods.name: ValidateContainerResourceName
methods.description: Validates that a resource name for a container is standard or properly extended.

methods.name: ValidateResourceQuantityValue
methods.description: Ensures a resource quantity is non-negative and an integer if required.

methods.name: ValidateNonnegativeQuantity
methods.description: Checks that a resource.Quantity is not negative.

methods.name: validateResourceName
methods.description: Validates that a resource name is qualified and standard.

methods.name: ValidatePodLogOptions
methods.description: Validates options for pod log retrieval, including tail lines, limit bytes, and stream options.

methods.name: AccumulateUniqueHostPorts
methods.description: Detects duplicate host ports across containers.
